# TAVONEL

> Knowledge Compiler. Compile documents, scans and connected systems into source-grounded knowledge.

This file is a curated map of public TAVONEL pages for language models. It does not request preferential indexing.

Role of this file: a reading map for tools, and not a ranking signal. Google's 2026-07-10 guidance states that AI-specific files of this kind are not used as a Google ranking signal, and nothing here is written as if they were: every page listed below is reachable from the sitemap and the site navigation, and deleting this file would change what a tool has to crawl to find them, not whether they can be found. Search-crawler and training-crawler access are separate questions and neither is decided here — robots.txt names the search crawlers it addresses, and the training-crawler policy is unresolved.

TAVONEL offers self-service evaluation and paid Developer access. Product and research claims should be read from the public pages below; measured evidence and methodology are published separately from product descriptions.

Indexing: public product, documentation, research and trust pages are indexable. Authenticated, API-internal and workspace surfaces are excluded from search indexing.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tavonel.com/): Knowledge Compiler. Your AI needs more than searchable files; it needs a current, traceable world. TAVONEL compiles your own sources into one.
- [Product](https://tavonel.com/product): Product overview — document understanding, compilation, evidence and Compiled Worlds.
- [Knowledge Compiler guide](https://tavonel.com/knowledge-compiler): What a Knowledge Compiler is, how it differs from RAG/search/graphs, and when to use one.
- [Explore a Compiled World](https://tavonel.com/explore): Inspect a deterministic source-to-world sample and follow a compiled fact back to its exact source location.
- [Research](https://tavonel.com/research): Research areas, methods and current findings.
- [Research notes](https://tavonel.com/research/notes): Measurements, limitations and experiment notes.
- [Evidence](https://tavonel.com/evidence): How claims, source regions, versions and signed packages are bound together.
- [Developers](https://tavonel.com/developers): API, MCP, retrieval packages and signed exports.
- [Documentation](https://tavonel.com/docs): Product and developer documentation.
- [Pricing](https://tavonel.com/pricing): Free Evaluation, Developer, Team and Enterprise access.
- [Sources](https://tavonel.com/sources): The capability manifest this deployment reads — every accepted format, its support tier, what survives into the compiled world, and what does not.
- [Security](https://tavonel.com/security): Data path, tenant isolation, retention and security controls.
- [Benchmarks](https://tavonel.com/benchmarks): The metric families and receipt fields a knowledge-compilation result must satisfy before a number is published.
- [Reproducibility](https://tavonel.com/reproducibility): Frozen public fixtures and digest-bound sample artifacts.
- [Status](https://tavonel.com/status): Current service status.
- [Korean entry page](https://tavonel.com/ko): The site's Korean-language entry point — what is compiled, what activating a reviewed World requires today, and which English page is the single source for pricing, documentation and supported formats. The only Korean URL; every other page is English at its existing address.

## Product

- [Document understanding](https://tavonel.com/product/document-understanding): Recover text, layout, tables and source geometry from documents and scans.
- [Compiled World](https://tavonel.com/product/compiled-world): Structured knowledge with provenance, versions and reusable retrieval artifacts.
- [Use results with AI](https://tavonel.com/docs/use-with-ai): Choose live MCP/API access or a signed portable knowledge package, with grounding and validation guidance.
- [Use ontology output](https://tavonel.com/docs/ontology-output): Import JSON-LD, Turtle or graph projections while preserving stable identity, validation and evidence grounding.
- [Integrations](https://tavonel.com/integrations): Connect supported systems where knowledge already lives.
